description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'html_options' that generates HTML <select> elements with options, including support for optgroups and selected options.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options
methods.description: Generates an HTML <select> element with options based on provided parameters.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optoutput
methods.description: Creates an individual <option> or <optgroup> HTML element.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optgroup
methods.description: Creates an <optgroup> HTML element containing multiple options.
